title: Master Data Expert & Business Analyst, Procurement
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make As our Master Data Expert & Business Analyst , Procurement you’ll play a key role in combining analytical skills, master data expertise, and project management to strengthen procurement processes. You’ll ensure high-quality procurement data, deliver actionable insights, and support Procurement Controllers with KPI tracking and analysis. Your work will improve decision-making, enhance efficiency, and drive sustainable procurement practices across divisions and business units. You’ll collaborate with Controllers, Supplier Responsible teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, taking ownership of procurement master data governance, analysis, and improvement projects—helping us move toward a more structured, efficient, and data-driven future. What You’ll Be Doing
- Lead analysis of DPS delivery and quality metrics (PPM, OPM, OTD) to support performance improvement.
- Follow up on raw materials, including price vs. index analysis, completeness checks, and update reviews.
- Extract and analyze SAP transactions & Business warehouse for forecast quantities, material master fields, and inforecord prices.
- Conduct analysis of payment terms development, excluded materials, and offset processes.
- Own procurement master data governance: creation, maintenance, auditing, and continuous improvement of vendor master, info-records, source lists, and material master data.
- Align roles and responsibilities for data governance, coordinate structural changes, and communicate updates.
- Design and implement improvement areas based on root cause analysis, including training material preparation and rollout.
- Run procurement data improvement projects across all DPS divisions and business units. What We're Looking For
- At least 5 years of business experience with a Bachelor’s degree or higher.
- Strong expertise in procurement master data, SAP purchasing transactions, and MDG.
- Advanced Excel skills for handling very large datasets; Power BI basics (queries, refreshing, error resolution) are an advantage.
- Proven ability to work independently, manage tasks/projects, and deliver high-quality data on time.
- Excellent English communication skills (verbal and written), with the ability to engage across all organizational levels.
- Self-driven, structured, and committed to exceeding expectations with a mindset of continuous improvement and collaboration. title: Senior Penetration Tester - Embedded Cybersecurity
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make Are you an offensive security expert with a passion for breaking embedded systems? title: Architect, OnePLM
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make As an Architect – One PLM , you shape how product data, processes, and collaboration come together across Danfoss. Your work directly supports engineers, manufacturing teams, and business leaders by enabling a reliable, scalable PLM landscape that helps them deliver better products, faster. You turn complex business needs into practical PLM solutions that improve efficiency, data quality, and decision-making across the product lifecycle. By doing so, you play a key role in Danfoss’ digital transformation and long-term competitiveness. This role gives you the opportunity to influence global standards, guide critical technology choices, and create solutions that are used every day across multiple business segments. What You’ll Be Doing
- Translate business needs into PLM solutions by working closely with stakeholders and shaping clear, scalable architectures.
- Design and configure Teamcenter solutions that improve usability, performance, and process consistency across functions.
- Support solution delivery by contributing to effort estimates, prototypes, and high-quality implementations.
- Resolve complex PLM issues while safeguarding system stability, data integrity, and integrations with SAP.
- Strengthen PLM capabilities by sharing knowledge, mentoring colleagues, and driving continuous improvement. What We're Looking For
- Hands-on experience with Teamcenter (UA, AWC) and PLM solution design in an enterprise environment.
- Strong understanding of core PLM domains , such as CAD integration, change and document management, and manufacturing processes.
- Experience with PLM integrations , especially SAP, and PLM configuration or customization tools (e.g., ITK, SOA, BMIDE).
- Solid software development foundation , including modern web technologies and agile ways of working.
- Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. What You'll Get from Us At Danfoss, you join a global company where technology, sustainability, and people development go hand in hand. You can expect:
- Meaningful work with global impact , contributing to products and solutions used worldwide.
- Strong learning and development support , including access to modern tools, knowledge sharing, and expert communities.
- A collaborative and inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued and ideas are encouraged.
- Clear opportunities to grow your technical expertise and influence architectural decisions over time.
- A balanced work environment built on trust, flexibility, and mutual respect. Ready to Make a Difference? If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category. title: Senior Analyst, Manufacturing Engineering
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make As our Senior Analyst, Manufacturing Engineering , you’ll play a key role in driving manufacturing excellence by improving process efficiency, product quality, and operational performance to support reliable and sustainable operations. You will help improve productivity, reduce waste and downtime, strengthen process capability, and ensure stable manufacturing performance that supports customer delivery and business goals. You’ll collaborate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams while taking ownership of process improvement initiatives, engineering documentation, and operational performance optimization to help us build a more efficient and continuous-improvement-driven future. What You’ll Be Doing
- Identify, develop, and implement continuous improvement projects to enhance productivity, reduce waste, and optimize machine performance.
- Track, analyze, and report actual vs. standard consumption, implementing corrective actions for process deviations.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve process-related issues and align operational objectives.
- Develop and maintain PFMEA, Control Plans, Standard Work, and other engineering documentation.
- Lead structured problem-solving activities (4Step, 8D, DMAIC) to eliminate chronic defects, improve first-pass yield, strengthen process capability, and reduce variability.
- Improve equipment performance, reduce downtime, identify bottlenecks using data analytics, and support smooth production flow and material movement.
- Support production planning and scheduling by eliminating constraints and contributing to stable manufacturing performance and customer service objectives.
- Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives across operations. What We're Looking For
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering with mandatory experience in Hydraulics and a strong ability to drive manufacturing and process improvements.
- 8+ years of Manufacturing Engineering experience in Hydraulics, Control Valves, Pumps, and Proportional Valves within a manufacturing environment.
- Strong hands-on troubleshooting skills with machinery and equipment such as Hydraulic Test Stands and assembly equipment to ensure operational reliability and efficiency.
- Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DOE, and structured root-cause analysis methodologies to improve quality and process capability.
- Proficiency in CAD, process documentation, and data analysis tools, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The Functional Safety & Software Quality Expert will perform safety activities in development projects according to IEC 61508 and ISO 26262 requirements. The role will manage or develop Functional Safety work products like Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessments, Safety Concepts, SIL/ASIL assignments/decomposition, Functional Safety Management Plans, Requirements and Safety Requirements, FMEDAs, SFMEAs. Bachelors’ degree in Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or comparable degree required. Background in embedded systems development is a plus. The Impact You'll Make Danfoss Power Solutions is seeking a Senior Software Test Engineer to join our System Development Tools team, building a global development partner hub in Pune. You will work on our core software platforms:
- PLUS+1® GUIDE – A graphical development environment for rapid configuration of electrohydraulic control systems via drag‑and‑drop blocks, C/PLCOpen integration, and safety-certified tooling.
- PLUS+1® Service Tool – Sophisticated tool for flashing hardware, parameter tuning, diagnostics, log data capture, and building custom service interfaces.
- You may also work with PLUS+1® Mobile Service Tool for wireless diagnostics and mobile-based tooling. Job Description Req ID: 48407 Job Location: Pune, IN Employment Type: Full Time Segment: Danfoss Power Solutions Segment Job Category: R&D, Technology and Engineering Work Location Type: On-site Job Title: Sr. Software Test Engineer The Impact You'll Make Danfoss Power Solutions is seeking a Senior Software Test Engineer to join our System Development Tools team, building a global development partner hub in Pune. - PLUS+1® GUIDE – A graphical development environment for rapid configuration of electrohydraulic control systems via drag‑and‑drop blocks, C/PLCOpen integration, and safety-certified tooling.

- Ability to test desktop GUI tools (like GUIDE) and engineering diagnostics tools (Service Tool).

- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Engineering or Computer Science.
- 5+ years in software test engineering with automation experience.

The Impact You'll Make Job Description Req ID: 48436 Job Location: Pune, IN Employment Type: Full Time Segment: Danfoss Power Solutions Segment Job Category: R&D, Technology and Engineering Work Location Type: On-site Job Title: Software Engineer The Impact You'll Make Danfoss Power Solutions is seeking a Software Developer to join our System Development Tools team. You will be part of a collaborative environment working on desktop applications that enable our customers to configure, tune, and commission advanced platforms through tools like the PLUS+1® Service Tool. While the core development team is based in Älmhult, Sweden, we are strengthening our partner team in Pune, India, to contribute actively to the design, development, and support of our tools. What You’ll Be Doing As a Software Developer, you will play a key role in designing and building the next generation of our configuration tools by: Developing and maintaining desktop applications using C#, .NET Framework, and WPF. Participating in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Collaborating with global teams to enhance tool functionality and user experience. Supporting and extending existing features based on customer and stakeholder feedback. Ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and well-documented code. What We're Looking For Core Technologies & Programming: 4+ years of experience as a .NET Engineer. Proficiency in C#, .NET Framework/.NET Core, and Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF). Strong understanding of WPF architecture, data binding, and MVVM or MVC architectural patterns. Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), modern design patterns, and SOLID principles. Experience integrating with APIs and web services. Software Development Practices: Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in an SDLC environment. Familiarity with Azure Dev Ops or similar Dev Ops platforms. Experience with unit and integration testing. Strong understanding of threading concepts and asynchronous programming. Additional Technical Skills: Working knowledge of databases such as SQL Server or Oracle. Basic knowledge of C++, Python, and azure is a plus.

title: Warranty Technician
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make As our Warranty Techician, you’ll play a key role in delivering exceptional customer experience by providing technical field support, driving effective failure analysis, and ensuring timely warranty resolution for hydraulic components on Application across India. You will help customers through rapid troubleshooting, evidence-based warranty assessment, and effective containment actions. By identifying root causes, supporting quality improvements, and enabling successful product performance in the field, you will strengthen customer trust, reduce recurring issues, and contribute to continuous product and process improvement. You’ll collaborate with Account Manager (Sales Team) Application Engineering, Product Application Engineering, Plant Quality, Manufacturing teams, and customers while taking ownership of field failure analysis, warranty management, customer support activities, and technical problem resolution, helping us move toward a more reliable, customer-centric, and quality-driven future. What You’ll Be Doing
- Perform on-site failure analysis, troubleshooting, and technical support for hydraulic systems, components, and applications.
- Support customers through warranty claim validation, containment actions, retrofit activities, and timely issue resolution.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate chronic and recurring issues, conduct root cause analysis, and closely work on critical claims/claim prevention projects to identify the root cause and collaborate with plant quality and application team.
- Utilize SAP and quality tools to document, manage, and close warranty cases while preparing structured technical reports and supporting 8D investigations.
- Deliver customer training and support new product launches through on-site engagement, identifying assembly and process gaps to prevent future quality concerns. What We're Looking For
- Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, with 8–10 years of experience in hydraulics, field service, troubleshooting, and customer support.
- Strong technical expertise in hydraulic systems, hydraulic components, mobile and industrial hydraulic applications, and interpretation of hydraulic circuit diagrams.
- Experience using SAP (ERP) for warranty management, claim processing, documentation, and tracking activities.
- Ability to work independently at customer sites while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical issues.
- Strong problem-solving, root cause analysis, communication, and customer relationship skills, with a proactive mindset and willingness to travel extensively across India and occasionally internationally. jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make As our Manager- Product Engineering & Design Engineering , you will play a critical role in strengthening and evolving our global Fluid Conveyance product portfolio, including hoses, couplings, adapters, and fittings. You will lead engineering excellence by driving product innovation, enhancing value propositions, optimizing product lifecycle management processes, and delivering sustainable business growth. Your impact will be measured through improved product competitiveness, enhanced engineering efficiency, successful product launches, stronger stakeholder engagement, and the development of a high-performing engineering organization. By enabling continuous improvement, cost optimization, and operational excellence, you will help deliver innovative solutions that create value for customers and the business worldwide. You will collaborate closely with global Product Engineering, Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Business teams while leading a team of engineers supporting Fluid Conveyance locations across the globe. Together, you will advance a more innovative, efficient, and customer-focused future. What You’ll Be Doing
- Lead and develop a global Product Engineering and Design Engineering team, ensuring high-quality deliverables, talent growth, and organizational capability development.
- Drive engineering excellence by introducing technical differentiators, supporting product innovation, and identifying cost reduction and value engineering opportunities across the Fluid Conveyance portfolio.
- Develop and implement continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging methodologies such as DFSS, DMAIC, Lean, VA/VE, and Danfoss Business System practices.
- Partner with cross-functional and global stakeholders to execute product engineering strategies, optimize PLM processes, and ensure successful product launches and lifecycle management.
- Manage resource allocation, project prioritization, engineering budgets, and team performance to consistently achieve objectives related to quality, delivery, cycle time, and customer satisfaction. What We're Looking For
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience leading technical engineering teams.
- 10–12 years of experience in Product Engineering, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), CAD tools, and engineering processes, preferably within a multinational engineering environment.
- Strong knowledge of engineering excellence methodologies such as Lean, DMAIC, DFSS, Value Engineering, Project Management, and continuous improvement practices.
- Proven ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders, customers, and cross-cultural teams while managing multiple priorities and business objectives.
- A leadership mindset characterized by accountability, proactive communication, collaboration, continuous learning, problem-solving, and a passion for developing people and driving organizational success. What You'll Get from Us
- We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
- You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.
- We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
- You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great. Ready to Make a Difference? title: Penetration Tester, Embedded Cybersecurity
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make Job Description Req ID: 50591 Job Location: Pune, IN Employment Type: Full Time Segment: Danfoss Power Solutions Segment Job Category: R&D, Technology and Engineering Work Location Type: On-site Job Title: Penetration Tester, Embedded Cybersecurity The Impact You'll Make Are you an offensive security expert with a passion for breaking embedded systems? Danfoss is seeking a talented and experienced Penetration Tester to join our Cybersecurity Team in Danfoss Power Solutions. If you're ready to deconstruct cutting-edge hardware, reverse-engineer firmware, and secure the devices that power modern industry, we want to hear from you What You’ll Be Doing As a Cybersecurity Penetration Tester, you will be at the forefront of our product security efforts. Your key responsibilities will include: Performing In-Depth Security Assessments: Conduct detailed penetration testing on our embedded devices and Io T products. This includes identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities across various attack surfaces, including CAN interfaces, UDS services (specifically Service 29), and JTAG interfaces. Hardware and Firmware Analysis: Perform hardware teardowns, reverse-engineer firmware, and analyze binaries to uncover deep-seated vulnerabilities in our products. Analyzing and Mitigating Vulnerabilities: Assess the security of cryptographic implementations like AES-128 and RSA-2k , evaluate secure boot mechanisms, and test certificate-based authentication solutions. Collaborate with our teams to develop and implement effective remediation strategies. Developing Comprehensive Reports: Create detailed reports outlining your findings, methodologies, and actionable recommendations for stakeholders. Collaborating with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with security analysts, solution architects, and embedded developers to enhance our security posture from the ground up. Simulating Real-World Attacks: Conduct physical security tests focused on device tampering, glitching, side-channel analysis, and other hardware-level attack scenarios. What We're Looking For We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled individual with the following

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is a plus. Experience: 2-4 years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, with a strong focus on embedded systems, Io T, or hardware security. Certifications: Industry certifications such as Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) are highly desirable. Certifications focused on exploit development or hardware hacking (e.g., OSED, SANS SEC617) are a significant plus. Core Embedded Security Expertise: Deep understanding of embedded systems architecture and low-level hardware interfaces ( JTAG, SWD, UART, SPI, I2C ). Hands-on experience with automotive or industrial communication protocols, particularly CAN bus and UDS diagnostics. Strong knowledge of embedded security concepts, including Secure Boot, Trust Zone/TEEs, and hardware-backed key storage. Practical experience testing cryptographic implementations ( AES-128, RSA-2k ) and certificate-based authentication schemes. Technical Skills & Tools: Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (Python, Bash, C/C++). Experience with embedded operating systems (e.g., Embedded Linux, RTOS like Free RTOS, QNX ). Familiarity with hardware and firmware analysis tools such as JTAG debuggers (J-Link), logic analyzers, bus sniffers (CANalyzer), Ghidra, IDA Pro, and firmware extraction tools. What You'll Get from Us We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are. You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great. Ready to Make a Difference? If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category. These activities include designing and maintaining models, object dependencies, system tables, classification hierarchies, material masters rules for complex products. You will be delivering value to the Danfoss organization by implementing and maintaining Rulestream solutions dedicated to our products in collaboration with a team of experts in engineering and software development. What You'll Be Doing Define & own all components of the technological solution (inference/rules engine; integrations, & UI) & data model including solution specifications (Technical Design Document), software configuration & code, and associated IT infrastructure. Gain deep understanding of business processes from ITO (Inquiry to Order) to OTR (Order to Requisition), to design and develop a robust solution/system technology framework to meet business, functional and user requirements. Design/architecture and develop/maintain Rulestream applications with PLM (Team Center), CAD (e.g., NX, Inventor) and other Enterprise Applications such as ERP (e.g., SAP). Where required, lead and direct junior (Rulestream or Teamcenter Product Configurator) architects/developer resources engaged in understanding the business requirements, developing and delivering IT system solutions, promoting conformance to established system and define solution architecture standards and best practices. Creation and maintenance of databases in SQL server management. Ability to anticipate customer needs and ensure that they are transferred in robust improvement and simplification programs Support migration from existing database/System to defined / developed configuration frameworks. Support the creation and maintenance of technical documentation (User manual, Design specifications). Prepare accurate implementation and delivery plans as per functional specifications, quality standards and project schedules Support organization to troubleshoot and solve bugs and perform root cause analysis. What We're Looking For Candidates with a Mechanical Engineering background should be considered.We are also open to engineers from relevant background provided as they meet the role requirements. Strong understanding of the interface between Sales and Engineering, the decision-making parameters that govern Engineer-to-order (ETO) Knowledge on Project Management is an advantage. Strong focus on testing and quality assurance. title: Engineer
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make As our Customer Quality Engineer , you'll play a key role in ensuring customer satisfaction by driving product quality, resolving customer concerns, and strengthening quality systems across manufacturing and new product development. You'll help improve product reliability, reduce customer complaints, enhance manufacturing quality, and ensure successful product launches through robust quality planning and continuous improvement initiatives. Your work will directly contribute to delivering world-class customer experiences while supporting operational excellence. You'll collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Customer Quality, Suppliers, Operations, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering, and global stakeholders, taking ownership of customer quality management, quality planning, audits, and problem-solving activities to help us build a more reliable and customer-focused future. What You’ll Be Doing
- Lead customer quality activities by managing customer complaints, warranty returns, material returns, and driving effective corrective and preventive actions using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D and A3.
- Support new product development by leading quality deliverables including APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, First Pass Yield (FPY), and customer quality approvals.
- Conduct failure analysis through hands-on inspection, assembly/disassembly of hydraulic components, product testing, and preparation of detailed inspection reports.
- Drive continuous improvement by leading internal process audits, supporting ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 audits, monitoring customer scorecards, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve quality performance. What We're Looking For
- Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 7–10 years of experience in Manufacturing Quality or Customer Quality within an engineering or automotive industry.
- Strong knowledge of Quality Core Tools including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, Gage R&R, Process Capability, GD&T, Root Cause Analysis, and Six Sigma methodologies.
- Experience in customer complaint handling, warranty analysis, customer audits, supplier/customer interactions, and structured problem-solving using 8D, A3, Shainin DOE, or similar methodologies.
- Good understanding of hydraulic systems, engineering drawings, measurement techniques, and experience with quality equipment such as CMM and Perthometer will be an advantage.
- Proficiency in SAP, CRM, Microsoft Office, and Power BI, with excellent analytical, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills What You'll Get from Us

Support new product development by leading quality deliverables including APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, First Pass Yield (FPY), and customer quality approvals.
Conduct failure analysis through hands-on inspection, assembly/disassembly of hydraulic components, product testing, and preparation of detailed inspection reports.

Drive continuous improvement by leading internal process audits, supporting ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 audits, monitoring customer scorecards, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve quality performance.

Strong knowledge of Quality Core Tools including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, Gage R&R, Process Capability, GD&T, Root Cause Analysis, and Six Sigma methodologies.
Experience in customer complaint handling, warranty analysis, customer audits, supplier/customer interactions, and structured problem-solving using 8D, A3, Shainin DOE, or similar methodologies.
Good understanding of hydraulic systems, engineering drawings, measurement techniques, and experience with quality equipment such as CMM and Perthometer will be an advantage.
Proficiency in SAP, CRM, Microsoft Office, and Power BI, with excellent analytical, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills

title: Senior Professional, BTP Developer
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make You will help shape how Danfoss delivers digital innovation by building modern, cloud-based solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . Your work will directly support global business processes that enable smarter decisions and seamless user experiences. By developing scalable SAP applications and intuitive Fiori interfaces, you will turn complex requirements into reliable solutions that colleagues across the organization depend on every day. At Danfoss, technology is a key enabler of sustainable growth. In this role, your expertise will strengthen our digital foundation while supporting our long-term ambition to engineer a better, more efficient future. What You’ll Be Doing
- Collaborate with IT functional consultants to translate business needs into scalable SAP BTP applications that deliver measurable value.
- Design, develop, and deploy cloud applications using RAP and CAPM in SAP Business Application Studio to support enterprise processes.
- Build and enhance SAP Fiori applications that deliver intuitive, high-quality user experiences aligned with SAP design standards.
- Automate and optimize business workflows using SAP Business Process Automation to improve efficiency and consistency.
- Integrate SAP and non-SAP systems securely , ensuring reliable data flow across platforms through modern integration approaches. What We're Looking For
- 6+ years of hands-on IT development experience , with a strong focus on SAP technologies and custom application development.
- Proven experience developing on SAP BTP , including practical use of RAP and CAPM in real project environments.
- Strong expertise in SAP Fiori development , including SAPUI5, Java Script, HTML5, CSS3, and OData services.
- Experience working in SAP Business Application Studio (BAS) to build, test, and deploy cloud-based applications.
- Solid understanding of integrations and secure solution design , with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams. What You'll Get from Us You’ll be part of a collaborative and inclusive environment where learning and growth are encouraged. Danfoss offers exposure to global SAP landscapes, opportunities to build deep cloud expertise, and the freedom to explore new technologies. At our Oragadam location, you’ll work with passionate colleagues who value trust, flexibility, and knowledge sharing. Your contributions will be recognized, and your development supported—both technically and professionally. Ready to Make a Difference?

Design, develop, and deploy cloud applications using RAP and CAPM in SAP Business Application Studio to support enterprise processes.
Build and enhance SAP Fiori applications that deliver intuitive, high-quality user experiences aligned with SAP design standards.
Automate and optimize business workflows using SAP Business Process Automation to improve efficiency and consistency.
Integrate SAP and non-SAP systems securely , ensuring reliable data flow across platforms through modern integration approaches.
6+ years of hands-on IT development experience , with a strong focus on SAP technologies and custom application development.
Proven experience developing on SAP BTP , including practical use of RAP and CAPM in real project environments.
Strong expertise in SAP Fiori development , including SAPUI5, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and OData services.
Experience working in SAP Business Application Studio (BAS) to build, test, and deploy cloud-based applications.
Solid understanding of integrations and secure solution design , with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams.

jobDescription: The Impact You'll Make Job Description Req ID: 49063 Job Location: Oragadam, IN Employment Type: Full Time Segment: Danfoss Power Electronics and Drives Segment Job Category: R&D, Technology and Engineering Work Location Type: On-site Job Title: EMC Test Engineer(External) The Impact You'll Make As our Power electronics EMC Test Engineer, you’ll play a key role in developing the next generation of power electronics solutions that power a more sustainable and energy-efficient future. Working from our on-site Chennai location, you will help ensure our products meet global electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) requirements while delivering reliable performance for customers worldwide. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will combine EMC testing expertise with power electronics knowledge to influence product design from development through validation. Your work will directly contribute to the quality, safety, and compliance of innovative drive technologies. You’ll join a collaborative product development environment where your insights, problem-solving skills, and technical expertise help transform ideas into market-ready solutions that make a real difference. What You’ll Be Doing Execute EMC validation testing using specialized equipment to evaluate product performance and compliance. Assess products against international EMC standards to support successful certification and market readiness. Analyze test results and recommend design improvements that reduce electromagnetic interference and enhance product reliability. Create clear test plans, compliance documentation, and validation reports that support development and certification activities. Maintain EMC laboratory quality and calibration practices to ensure accurate, repeatable, and reliable test outcomes. What We're Looking For Experience performing EMI/EMC testing and validation for power electronics, power converters, or related systems. Strong understanding of conducted and radiated emissions, noise sources, and EMC mitigation techniques such as filtering, shielding, grounding, and choke selection. Hands-on experience with EMC test and measurement equipment, including spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, oscilloscopes, and LISNs. Ability to interpret and apply relevant EMC standards, including CISPR, IEC/EN 61000, IEC 61800, or equivalent frameworks. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills with the ability to work across product development teams. What You'll Get from Us At Danfoss, you’ll be part of a purpose-driven company committed to engineering solutions that support the global transition toward a more sustainable future. You’ll have opportunities to: Work on advanced power electronics technologies and new product development projects. Collaborate with experienced engineers in a global and innovative environment. Expand your technical expertise through continuous learning and challenging engineering problems. Make a visible impact on products used by customers around the world. Build your career within a company that values curiosity, inclusion, teamwork, and professional growth. Ready to Make a Difference? If you're excited about solving complex EMC challenges and contributing to innovative power electronics products, we’d love to hear from you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective, skills, and potential may be exactly what we’re looking for. title: Senior SAP AI Developer
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make You will shape how AI is applied across our SAP landscape—turning real business needs into practical, intelligent solutions that simplify work and improve reliability at scale. By building AI‑enabled applications and automations, you will help teams process information faster, improve data quality, and make better day‑to‑day decisions—without adding complexity. As part of our AI & Digital Acceleration team , you will contribute to a growing SAP AI ecosystem while continuously developing your skills on one of the most advanced enterprise platforms in the market. What You’ll Be Doing
- Design and deliver AI‑enabled applications using SAP Build and SAP AI services to streamline core business processes.
- Create intelligent document processing solutions that automate data extraction, validation, and hand‑offs.
- Develop conversational or AI‑assisted features that improve user experience and decision support within SAP environments.
- Integrate SAP and non‑SAP systems through APIs to enable seamless, end‑to‑end automation.
- Collaborate closely with business and IT partners to translate needs into scalable, production‑ready solutions. What We're Looking For
- Experience building SAP‑based applications or automation solutions in a business environment.
- Hands‑on exposure to SAP Build, SAP BTP, or similar SAP development platforms .
- Practical programming skills in one or more languages such as ABAP, Java, Java Script, or Python.
- Working knowledge of APIs and system integration concepts.
- A curious, problem‑solving mindset with the ability to learn and apply new SAP AI capabilities . What You'll Get from Us You’ll join a collaborative environment where learning is encouraged and ideas move quickly from concept to impact. You’ll gain hands‑on experience with SAP’s latest AI and low‑code technologies, including generative AI and emerging tools like Joule. We offer clear ownership of meaningful work, strong collaboration across business and IT, and continuous opportunities to grow your technical and professional skills. Most importantly, you’ll see your solutions making a real difference—used at scale, every day. Ready to Make a Difference? If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category. title: Senior SAP Variant Configuration Consultant
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make You will shape how complex, configurable products are sold, priced, and delivered—by building reliable, scalable SAP Variant Configuration solutions that support Danfoss’ global growth and digital transformation. Working at the intersection of SAP, integrations, and cloud technologies , you will ensure system stability while helping the business transition to S/4HANA Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC) . Your work will directly improve customer experience, solution quality, and speed to market. This is a hands‑on consulting role where your technical insight and systems thinking help global teams move faster, smarter, and with confidence. What You’ll Be Doing
- Design and evolve SAP Variant Configuration and Pricing solutions to support complex business scenarios across S/4HANA landscapes
- Enable end‑to‑end integrations across SAP and cloud platforms, ensuring stable data flows and scalable architectures
- Support the migration from LO‑VC to S/4HANA Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC) , translating business needs into robust IT solutions
- Ensure system reliability by resolving incidents, performing root‑cause analysis, and implementing long‑term improvements
- Collaborate with global IT and business teams to deliver enhancements, upgrades, and modernization initiatives—including AI‑ and automation‑driven improvements What We're Looking For
- Strong hands‑on experience with SAP Variant Configuration , including S/4HANA Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC)
- Exposure to or experience with LO‑VC to AVC migration in enterprise SAP environments
- Solid understanding of SAP and cloud integrations , such as APIs, IDocs, BAPIs, or similar technologies
- Experience working in complex, global IT landscapes , contributing to projects and change initiatives
- Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and functional teams What You'll Get from Us At Danfoss, you’ll join a purpose‑driven global organization committed to engineering solutions that enable a sustainable future . You can expect meaningful work with real impact , opportunities to grow your SAP and integration expertise, and collaboration with skilled colleagues across regions and disciplines. We support flexible, hybrid ways of working from our Chennai (Oragadam) location and encourage continuous learning, innovation, and ownership. Ready to Make a Difference? title: IBP Consultant, Operation Planning
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make Danfoss Central SIOP (Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning) function is looking for an IBP (Integrated Business Planning) Supply Planning Consultant with extensive knowlegde of S&OP who will be responsible for implementing and optimizing SAP IBP solutions to improve supply chain planning and execution. Job Description Req ID: 47457 Job Location: Oragadam, IN Employment Type: Full Time Segment: Group Functions CFO Job Category: Information Technology Work Location Type: On-site Job Title: IBP Consultant, Operation Planning The Impact You'll Make Danfoss Central SIOP (Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning) function is looking for an IBP (Integrated Business Planning) Supply Planning Consultant with extensive knowlegde of S&OP who will be responsible for implementing and optimizing SAP IBP solutions to improve supply chain planning and execution. The role involves working with stakeholders to design and configure IBP modules, ensuring alignment with business goals and processes across the company. Your daily work will significantly contribute to the enhancing forecasting accuracy, cashflow and supply planning and must be driven by a front line passion to improve delivery performance and thereby customer experience. What You’ll Be Doing Solution Design & Implementation : Configuring SAP IBP modules focussed on Supply Planning, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Inventory Optimization, and Control Tower. Gathering business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Integration & Data Management. Connecting SAP IBP with other SAP systems (e.g., SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA) and third-party applications. Managing data migration and ensuring seamless data flow across systems. Process Optimization. Improving planning efficiency and enhancing forecasting accuracy. Support & Training. Providing technical support and conducting training sessions. What We're Looking For

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred). Experience: More than 3 years of hands-on experience in SAP IBP implementations along with strong knowledge of IBP modules and configuration. Technical Skills : 3 + years expertise in S&OP, focused on forecast constraining, S&OP process execution and executive handshakes English language : Ability to communicate, to read and to write fluently. Soft Skills : Excellent communication and stakeholder management. Strong analytical skills to analyze complex data and provide actionable insights. Certifications : SAP IBP certification is a plus. What You'll Get from Us You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. title: Sales Manager South India
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make As our Sales Manager – South India, Danfoss Climate Solutions, you will be responsible for driving profitable growth, expanding market reach, and building strong strategic customer relationships across the region. Your impact? You will help customers adopt innovative and energy-efficient solutions while strengthening Danfoss’ market presence and accelerating sustainable business growth. You’ll work closely with sales, marketing, and application teams while managing customer accounts, sales opportunities, forecasting, and business development activities — helping us create a more sustainable future. What You’ll Be Doing
- Lead sales and business development activities to drive growth of Danfoss High Pressure Pumps across assigned markets.
- Support customers and channel partners by providing technical guidance, product presentations, and solution-based proposals.
- Collaborate with End Users, EPCs, Consultants, OEMs, and internal teams to develop and close business opportunities.
- Use your expertise in value selling, CRM management, and market analysis to strengthen customer engagement and expand sales opportunities.
- Continuously monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to enhance business performance and customer success. What We're Looking For
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, or Environmental Engineering with 8+ years of sales experience in the water treatment industry; experience in High-Pressure Pumps and Energy Recovery Devices is an advantage.
- Strong expertise in value selling, CRM tools, and customer engagement with Water Treatment Companies.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a matrix organization.
- Self-motivated professional with strong time management skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
- Proficient in MS Office applications, fluent in English, and willing to travel up to 40% across India and occasionally abroad. What You'll Get from Us
- We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

- You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great. Ready to Make a Difference? title: Assistant Manager, Sales Development
jobDescription:
The Impact You'll Make As our Sales Development Manager for Water Segment for sensing solutions in Danfoss Climate solutions, you’ll play a key role in identifying, monitoring and analysing water segment trends in India to uncover opportunities for Sensing Solutions products. Drive growth through channel partners, distributors, and integrators, ensuring alignment with Danfoss’ energy efficiency goals in India region. Engaging within a dynamic cross-functional team, you will collaborate closely with key stakeholders from other teams to enhance market reach and enable growth of Sensing Solutions products. Develop strategies and initiatives to expand adoption of Sensing Solutions in water applications, Smart Irrigation, Pumping System, Network Pressure management and Fire Pump systems. What You’ll Be Doing
- Drive sales growth for Sensing Solutions across water segment applications — including Smart Irrigation, Pumping Systems, Network Pressure Management, and Fire Pump systems — by developing channel partners, distributors, and integrators
- Build and share deep market and customer insights across cross-functional teams, using competitor analysis and emerging trends to shape commercial strategies and identify new opportunities
- Manage a quality opportunity pipeline by visiting customers, presenting tailored solutions, and introducing new products that align with evolving needs

- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to position Danfoss solutions effectively, driving marketing activities while fostering a customer-centric, one-company culture What We're Looking For

title: Senior Professional, Client Engineering
jobDescription: The Impact You'll Make As a Senior Client Engineering Specialist , you will help shape the digital workplace experience for employees across Danfoss. By delivering secure, reliable, and modern endpoint services, you will enable colleagues around the world to stay connected, productive, and protected. Job Description Req ID: 50856 Job Location: Oragadam, IN Employment Type: Full Time Segment: Group Functions CFO Job Category: Information Technology Work Location Type: On-site Job Title: Senior Professional, Client Engineering The Impact You'll Make As a Senior Client Engineering Specialist , you will help shape the digital workplace experience for employees across Danfoss. By delivering secure, reliable, and modern endpoint services, you will enable colleagues around the world to stay connected, productive, and protected. You will play a key role in managing and enhancing workplace technologies, including Windows devices, mobile devices, endpoint security, connectivity, and authentication services. Your expertise will directly contribute to a seamless and secure user experience across the enterprise. Working closely with infrastructure, network, cloud, security, and support teams, you will help drive continuous improvements that strengthen operational stability and support the future of digital work. What You’ll Be Doing Configure, maintain, and optimize client-side network devices (e.g., laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and network interface components) to ensure efficient and reliable connectivity. Troubleshoot complex network connectivity issues for end users, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions. Manage, troubleshoot, and support digital certificates to ensure secure authentication and encrypted communications. Collaborate with IT infrastructure teams to implement network policies and security standards for client devices. Monitor network performance from the client perspective and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reliability. Provide technical guidance and support to end users on connectivity and certificate-related matters. title: Sr Electronics Engineer
jobDescription: The Impact You'll Make As our Electronic Engineer , you’ll play a key role in improving and supporting existing product designs, addressing technical challenges, and ensuring product functionality meets the latest standards Job Description Req ID: 45759 Job Location: Pune, IN Employment Type: Full Time Segment: Danfoss Power Solutions Segment Job Category: R&D, Technology and Engineering Work Location Type: On-site Job Title: Sr Electronics Engineer The Impact You'll Make As our Electronic Engineer , you’ll play a key role in improving and supporting existing product designs, addressing technical challenges, and ensuring product functionality meets the latest standards Your impact? You’ll help strengthen the reliability and performance of our products through problem-solving, validation, and continuous improvement. Your work will directly benefit customers by delivering robust solutions while enabling cross-functional teams to operate more effectively. You’ll collaborate with R&D, Engineering, and cross-functional teams, and take ownership of product validation, technical support, and design improvements, helping us move toward a more innovative and sustainable future What You’ll Be Doing Conduct product maintenance and improvement (PMI) activities to ensure continuous enhancement of product performance and reliability. Support validation and verification testing, including EMI/EMC, thermal, and environmental, to meet compliance and quality standards. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external suppliers to drive seamless execution of product improvements and cost optimization. Use your skills in PCB design, circuit architecture, and microcontroller systems to analyze, optimize, and strengthen electronic designs. Continuously learn and apply knowledge in obsolescence management and new technologies to future-proof designs. Conduct analysis of analog and digital circuits, performing FMEA, stress, derating, worst-case, and tolerance analysis for robust design. Support resolution of functional, application, and production issues while ensuring efficiency and sustainability. What We're Looking For Experience in Electronics/Electrical engineering with 4–8 years of relevant work, and a strong ability to solve complex technical problems. Proficiency in core engineering tools and technologies, with solid technical know-how and logical thinking. Ability to work well as a team player, building strong networks and collaborating effectively across functions. Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with good interpersonal abilities. A mindset of problem-solving, persistence, openness, and continuous improvement What You'll Get from Us We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are. You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great. Ready to Make a Difference? If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.
